name: narrated-design-walkthrough
description: Generate derivative Slidev walkthroughs with curated TTS narration from canonical engineering design docs. Turns docs/design or docs/plans Markdown into an audio-first, phase-aware narrated walkthrough.

interface.shortDescription: Turn engineering design docs into narrated Slidev walkthroughs
interface.longDescription: Generate a Slidev presentation with per-slide TTS narration from canonical docs/design or docs/plans Markdown. The skill writes slides.md with spotlight markup, phase-aware narration cues, and the _addon playback engine — ready to dev-preview or build without touching the source docs.
defaultPrompt: Generate a narrated walkthrough from docs/design/my-feature-design.md
